text:
Alyssa: Starting the Nimbus Health POC thread. Scope: streaming SDK demo (Python -> Node later), function/tool-calls that return structured JSON for our ETL, SAML SSO, KMS for PHI, and reserved capacity pricing. Who can own end-to-end?
Tom H: I can own SDK integration and sample apps. Prefer starting with Python.
Priya S: Customer priorities: SAML (IdP metadata required), SOC2, signed DPA, and proof of KMS separation for PHI. They also asked about an on-prem toggle for specific workflows.
Kevin L: We have a SAML SP metadata template. @Alyssa drop their IdP XML and I'll map attributes. For capacity: they expect steady ~50 rps streaming, burst to 200. Need p50 <200ms at 50 rps target.
Alyssa: Uploaded IdP metadata + initial security answers: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus/poc (folder: security).
PresalesBot: POC ticket POC-3124 created. Owners: Alyssa, Tom H. Due date 2026-04-01.
Matt R: Example Python streaming + tool-call + structured output snippet for the demo harness:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with client.streaming.generate(model="rw-small-quant", stream=True) as s:
    s.call_tool("invoice_parser", {"url": invoice_url})
    for evt in s:
        if evt.type == "tool_output":
            # evt.text is JSON string, parse and validate
            print(evt.text)
```
Tom H: Good. I'll add a schema validator step that fails the POC run if the JSON doesn't match their contract. Also will add a curl + WebSocket example for their infra team.
Kevin L: Perf plan: run bench on rw-small-quant with 2x CPU batcher config, measure p50/p95 at 50rps and 200rps bursts. If p50 >200ms, plan fallback to hosted smaller model under traffic. @Tom H can you run perf today and upload results?
Tom H: Yep, running now. Will post results to the drive under tools/perf in ~45m.
Priya S: I'll finish the security questionnaire sections: encryption, key lifecycle, and on-prem options. Looping Legal for DPA and Compliance to attach SOC2 report.
Alyssa: Acceptance criteria to present to Nimbus: 1) streaming demo with tool-call returns structured JSON validated by our harness; 2) perf: p50 <200ms at sustained 50 rps; 3) SAML SSO end-to-end tested; 4) DPA signed + SOC2 on file. Proposed demo slot next Wed 10am PT.
Matt R: Quick perf command for the infra team: `wrk -t8 -c100 -d60 --script streaming.lua http://perf.local` (stream.lua uses persistent connections to mimic streaming).
Kevin L: Early capacity estimate: baseline 2k GPU-hours/month for Dedicated (rough), will refine after Tom's perf numbers. I'll draft commit proposal and fallback autoscale runbook (Dedicated -> canary autoscale -> hosted).
PresalesBot: Reminder: add billing contact to POC-3124 so finance can generate a formal estimate.
Tom H: Uploaded initial perf artifacts and sample payloads to the drive (tools/perf/nimbus). Linking logs and harness config.
Alyssa: Great. @Kevin L please post the refined commit estimate by EOD PT. Priya please confirm security QA + Legal DPA progress. We'll lock demo once perf + legal done. Thanks team :thumbsup:
